title: Waterfall: Seven injured after car smashes through a fence and onto train tracks in horror crash on NSW highway
text:
Great accident of three vehicles in princess highway in Waterfall, NSW South lanes are closed and six people have been hospitalized By Zak Wheeler for Daily Mail Australia
Published: 23:59 GMT, February 13, 2025 | Updated: 00:14 GMT, February 14, 2025
A horrible accident of three vehicles on an important road has caused chaos of vicinity and has increased fears about possible deaths.
A car was pushed through a fence and on train tracks after the accident on the princes road in Waterfall, in Sydney South, at 6.10 am on Friday.
Seven people participated in the accident and so far six men, among the ages of 18 in the mid -30s, have been hospitalized.
The lanes to the south of the road closed immediately when the emergency services attended the scene.
NSW police said the impact of the accident sent one of the cars through a nearby fence and in close train.
Of the hospitalized, two men were taken to the Liverpool hospital, two more were taken to the St George Hospital and two to the Wollongong hospital.
Currently, the condition of all involved, including the seventh patient, is unknown.
The photos of the scene show a UTE with its front part, another on its roof and a car that had been pushed out of the road and towards a post in the strip of nature.
An important three -car accident has caused chaos on the Princess Freeway highway at 6.10 am on Friday
Six people, between the ages of 18 and mid -30, have been hospitalized and the condition of a seventh is unknown.
More to come.
